summary: Express conditional and repeated JSX children as blocks spanning several children, so a falsy number cannot reach the output and a list cannot lose its key.

capabilities.requirement: Provide conditional and iteration blocks over JSX children.
Resolve a macro whose invocation spans several children of a JSX element.
Capture one JSX child, carrying the layout text around it.
Capture an optional trailing parameter and emit it only when present.

syntaxNotes: A block opens with a braced head naming the macro and closes with `{end}`.
`when` takes a condition and a child, with an optional `{else}` child.
`when` without `{else}` yields null, never the condition's own value.
`each` binds the element and an optional index over its child.
Layout text around a child belongs to the child, so a block need not mention it.

openDecisions.question: Should block syntax spanning several JSX children be dispatched through the jsxChild category?
